items.title: Apargon – Ask AI for any app and run it safely with a double-click
items.raw_excerpt:
Hi HN, I think I solved personal software. I have dozens of personal apps. One queues my social posts, one scores Reddit threads for me, one is the email client for my domains, others solve small and big problems I face. Every one of them is a freaking project! Dozens of files, a build, updates, some need a server, yada yada yada. All that for an app with one user - me. It annoyed me so much that I asked: Why do I need all of that?
Browsers open an HTML file with a double-click. No build, no server.
But a browser can't reach my laptop freely, and for a real app I need it to. Why can't desktop apps work the same way? So I built Apargon. Your AI writes one .papp (Personal App ;D) file. That's the whole app! It declares what it needs, you double-click it, see a popup with the contract, approv

items.title: Announcing SOCI-indexed images for faster SageMaker AI jobs
items.raw_excerpt: Seekable OCI (SOCI) indexing for Amazon SageMaker AI training and processing jobs takes full container image download off the critical path. SageMaker AI lazy-loads your image to start containers in seconds instead of minutes, with no changes to your job definition. See the benchmarks and how to adopt it.

items.title: Fix evaluation bias to unlock better models on Amazon Bedrock
items.raw_excerpt: Property Finder found that 96.8% of their vision-AI evaluation labels were inherited from the incumbent model, hiding its true accuracy. See how they built unbiased ground truth, applied evolutionary prompt optimization, and selected a more accurate, cost-effective model on Amazon Bedrock, cutting cost by 86% across 11 image-quality attributes.

items.title: Exowatt beats frontier models on accuracy with SageMaker serverless model customization
